name: Alcovia student dashboard
description: P4 · sample data, made up for illustration. Every card is a section of a KPI file from sql/kpis/p4_student_dashboard.

cards.name: 01 · Timetable management · Quantity: students with a timetable updated, per week
cards.sql:
-- P4 KPI 1: Timetable management  (Day)
-- Collection  : Automatic · 1-tap weekly pulse
-- Quantity    : % of students with an advisor-built weekly timetable, updated this week
-- Quality     : "Did your timetable work this week?" (1–5)
-- Performance : Timetable adherence: % of planned self-study slots that had a linked focus session
-- Source      : Advisor portal · Student app
-- Access      : full_access, team_access

WITH m AS (SELECT {{month}}::date AS s, ({{month}}::date + interval '1 month - 1 day')::date AS e), active AS (SELECT sm.student_id FROM students.student_month sm, m WHERE sm.month = m.s),
weeks AS (SELECT w::date AS week FROM m, generate_series(date_trunc('week', m.s), m.e, interval '7 days') w)
SELECT weeks.week,
       COUNT(DISTINCT ts.student_id) AS students_updated,
       (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM active) AS students,
       round(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT ts.student_id) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM active)) AS pct
FROM weeks LEFT JOIN students.timetable_slots ts ON ts.created_on = weeks.week
GROUP BY weeks.week ORDER BY weeks.week

cards.name: 01 · Timetable management · Quality: timetable pulse
cards.sql:
-- P4 KPI 1: Timetable management  (Day)
-- Collection  : Automatic · 1-tap weekly pulse
-- Quantity    : % of students with an advisor-built weekly timetable, updated this week
-- Quality     : "Did your timetable work this week?" (1–5)
-- Performance : Timetable adherence: % of planned self-study slots that had a linked focus session
-- Source      : Advisor portal · Student app
-- Access      : full_access, team_access

WITH m AS (SELECT {{month}}::date AS s, ({{month}}::date + interval '1 month - 1 day')::date AS e)
SELECT round(AVG(answer), 1) AS avg_answer, COUNT(*) AS responses
FROM students.pulse_responses, m
WHERE question = 'Did your timetable work this week?' AND asked_on BETWEEN m.s AND m.e

cards.name: 01 · Timetable management · Performance: timetable adherence
cards.sql:
-- P4 KPI 1: Timetable management  (Day)
-- Collection  : Automatic · 1-tap weekly pulse
-- Quantity    : % of students with an advisor-built weekly timetable, updated this week
-- Quality     : "Did your timetable work this week?" (1–5)
-- Performance : Timetable adherence: % of planned self-study slots that had a linked focus session
-- Source      : Advisor portal · Student app
-- Access      : full_access, team_access

WITH m AS (SELECT {{month}}::date AS s, ({{month}}::date + interval '1 month - 1 day')::date AS e)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS planned_slots,
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM students.app_sessions a WHERE a.linked_slot_id = ts.slot_id)) AS slots_with_linked_focus,
       round(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM students.app_sessions a WHERE a.linked_slot_id = ts.slot_id)) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0)) AS adherence_pct
FROM students.timetable_slots ts, m
WHERE ts.slot_date BETWEEN m.s AND m.e

cards.name: 02 · Daily 8 PM quiz · Quantity: quizzes published (held of days) and rating
cards.sql:
-- P4 KPI 2: Daily 8 PM quiz  (Day)
-- Collection  : Automatic · 1-tap rating
-- Quantity    : Quizzes published at 8 PM ÷ days in period
-- Quality     : Rating at the end of each quiz
-- Performance : Participation (% of students who took it) · accuracy % · trend per topic
-- Source      : Student app
-- Access      : full_access, team_access

WITH m AS (SELECT {{month}}::date AS s, ({{month}}::date + interval '1 month - 1 day')::date AS e)
SELECT SUM(d.held) AS held, SUM(d.planned) AS planned,
       round(100.0 * SUM(d.held) / NULLIF(SUM(d.planned), 0)) AS held_pct,
       round(SUM(d.rating_avg * d.ratings_n) / NULLIF(SUM(d.ratings_n), 0), 1) AS avg_rating, SUM(d.ratings_n) AS ratings,
       round(SUM(d.attendance_pct * d.held) / NULLIF(SUM(d.held) FILTER (WHERE d.attendance_pct IS NOT NULL), 0)) AS attendance_pct
FROM events.delivery_month d JOIN events.event_types t USING (event_type_id), m
WHERE t.name = '8 PM quiz' AND d.month BETWEEN m.s AND m.e AND d.planned > 0

cards.name: 02 · Daily 8 PM quiz · Performance: participation and accuracy (monthly summary)
cards.sql:
-- P4 KPI 2: Daily 8 PM quiz  (Day)

-- Performance : Participation (% of students who took it) · accuracy % · trend per topic
-- Source      : Student app

SELECT round(AVG(quiz_participation_pct), 1) AS participation_pct, round(AVG(quiz_accuracy_pct), 1) AS accuracy_pct
FROM students.student_month WHERE month = {{month}}::date

cards.name: 02 · Daily 8 PM quiz · Performance: accuracy by topic
cards.sql:
-- P4 KPI 2: Daily 8 PM quiz  (Day)
-- Collection  : Automatic · 1-tap rating
-- Quantity    : Quizzes published at 8 PM ÷ days in period
-- Quality     : Rating at the end of each quiz
-- Performance : Participation (% of students who took it) · accuracy % · trend per topic
-- Source      : Student app
-- Access      : full_access, team_access

WITH m AS (SELECT {{month}}::date AS s, ({{month}}::date + interval '1 month - 1 day')::date AS e), ev AS (SELECT e.* FROM events.events e JOIN events.event_types t USING (event_type_id), m WHERE t.name = '8 PM quiz' AND e.held_on BETWEEN m.s AND m.e)
SELECT qa.topic, COUNT(*) AS attempts, round(AVG(qa.score_pct), 1) AS accuracy_pct
FROM ev JOIN students.quiz_attempts qa USING (event_id)
GROUP BY qa.topic ORDER BY accuracy_pct

cards.name: 03 · Focus time · Quantity: plan pushed to the app
cards.sql:
-- P4 KPI 3: Focus time  (Day)
-- Collection  : Automatic
-- Quantity    : % of students with the advisor's plan pushed to the app (so linked focus is possible)
-- Quality     : Voluntary repeat use: % of students running focus on ≥5 days a week
-- Performance : Counted minutes per day vs. the 30-min target · streak length
-- Source      : Student app · Advisor portal
-- Access      : full_access, team_access

WITH m AS (SELECT {{month}}::date AS s, ({{month}}::date + interval '1 month - 1 day')::date AS e), active AS (SELECT sm.student_id FROM students.student_month sm, m WHERE sm.month = m.s)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ts.student_id) AS students_with_plan, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM active) AS students,
       round(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT ts.student_id) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM active)) AS pct
FROM students.timetable_slots ts, m WHERE ts.slot_date BETWEEN m.s AND m.e

cards.name: 03 · Focus time · Quality: voluntary repeat use (student-weeks with focus on 5+ days)
cards.sql:
-- P4 KPI 3: Focus time  (Day)
-- Collection  : Automatic
-- Quantity    : % of students with the advisor's plan pushed to the app (so linked focus is possible)
-- Quality     : Voluntary repeat use: % of students running focus on ≥5 days a week
-- Performance : Counted minutes per day vs. the 30-min target · streak length
-- Source      : Student app · Advisor portal
-- Access      : full_access, team_access

WITH m AS (SELECT {{month}}::date AS s, ({{month}}::date + interval '1 month - 1 day')::date AS e),
wk AS (SELECT student_id, date_trunc('week', started_at)::date AS week, COUNT(DISTINCT started_at::date) AS focus_days
       FROM students.app_sessions, m WHERE kind = 'Focus' AND started_at::date BETWEEN m.s AND m.e GROUP BY 1, 2)
SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE focus_days >= 5) AS student_weeks_5_plus, COUNT(*) AS student_weeks,
       round(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE focus_days >= 5) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0)) AS pct
FROM wk

cards.name: 03 · Focus time · Performance: counted minutes per day (study + quiz + games capped at half of study and quiz; monthly summary)
cards.sql:
-- P4 KPI 3: Focus time  (Day)
-- Collection  : Automatic
-- Quantity    : % of students with the advisor's plan pushed to the app (so linked focus is possible)
-- Quality     : Voluntary repeat use: % of students running focus on ≥5 days a week
-- Performance : Counted minutes per day vs. the 30-min target · streak length
-- Source      : Student app · Advisor portal
-- Access      : full_access, team_access

SELECT round(AVG(counted_min), 1) AS counted_min_per_day, 30 AS target,
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE counted_min >= 30) AS students_at_target, COUNT(*) AS students
FROM students.student_month WHERE month = {{month}}::date

cards.name: 03 · Focus time · Performance: longest focus streak per student (days in a row)
cards.sql:
-- P4 KPI 3: Focus time  (Day)
-- Collection  : Automatic
-- Quantity    : % of students with the advisor's plan pushed to the app (so linked focus is possible)
-- Quality     : Voluntary repeat use: % of students running focus on ≥5 days a week
-- Performance : Counted minutes per day vs. the 30-min target · streak length
-- Source      : Student app · Advisor portal
-- Access      : full_access, team_access

WITH m AS (SELECT {{month}}::date AS s, ({{month}}::date + interval '1 month - 1 day')::date AS e),
d AS (SELECT DISTINCT student_id, started_at::date AS day FROM students.app_sessions, m WHERE kind = 'Focus' AND started_at::date BETWEEN m.s AND m.e),
g AS (SELECT student_id, day - (ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY student_id ORDER BY day))::int AS grp FROM d),
streaks AS (SELECT student_id, COUNT(*) AS streak FROM g GROUP BY student_id, grp)
SELECT round(AVG(best), 1) AS avg_longest_streak, MAX(best) AS best_streak
FROM (SELECT student_id, MAX(streak) AS best FROM streaks GROUP BY student_id) s

cards.name: 04 · Active minutes · Quantity: health data connected
cards.sql:
-- P4 KPI 4: Active minutes  (Day)
-- Collection  : Automatic (one-time permission)
-- Quantity    : % of students with health data connected
-- Quality     : Not rated: passive data
-- Performance : Days with ≥60 active minutes
-- Source      : Apple Health / Health Connect via the app
-- Access      : full_access, team_access

SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE health_connected) AS connected, COUNT(*) AS students,
       round(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE health_connected) / COUNT(*)) AS pct
FROM students.students WHERE student_id IN (SELECT student_id FROM students.student_month)

cards.name: 04 · Active minutes · Performance: days with 60+ active minutes (monthly summary)
cards.sql:
-- P4 KPI 4: Active minutes  (Day)
-- Collection  : Automatic (one-time permission)

-- Quality     : Not rated: passive data
-- Performance : Days with ≥60 active minutes
-- Source      : Apple Health / Health Connect via the app
-- Access      : full_access, team_access

SELECT round(AVG(active_days_pct), 1) AS pct_days_60_plus, COUNT(active_days_pct) AS students_measured

cards.name: 05 · Active recovery (sleep) · Performance: sleep
cards.sql:
-- P4 KPI 5: Active recovery (sleep)  (Day)
-- Collection  : Automatic (one-time permission)
-- Quantity    : Same connection rate as active minutes
-- Quality     : Not rated: passive data
-- Performance : Average sleep hours vs. 8–10 h (teen guideline) · nights below 7 h
-- Source      : Apple Health / Health Connect via the app
-- Access      : full_access, team_access

WITH m AS (SELECT {{month}}::date AS s, ({{month}}::date + interval '1 month - 1 day')::date AS e)
SELECT (SELECT round(AVG(sleep_hrs), 1) FROM students.student_month WHERE month = m.s) AS avg_sleep_hrs,   -- monthly summary
       '8–10' AS guideline,
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE sleep_hrs < 7) AS nights_below_7h, COUNT(*) AS nights,                          -- daily health data
       round(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE sleep_hrs < 7) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0)) AS pct_below_7h
FROM students.health_daily, m WHERE day BETWEEN m.s AND m.e
GROUP BY m.s

cards.name: 06 · Weekly advisor session · Quantity and quality: sessions held of planned, student rating
cards.sql:
-- P4 KPI 6: Weekly advisor session  (Week)
-- Collection  : Host closes event · advisor notes
-- Quantity    : Sessions held ÷ planned, per student
-- Quality     : Student rating after the session (1–5)
-- Performance : Actions agreed last week that were completed
-- Source      : Event system · ClickUp notes → n8n + LLM
-- Access      : full_access, team_access

WITH m AS (SELECT {{month}}::date AS s, ({{month}}::date + interval '1 month - 1 day')::date AS e)
SELECT SUM(d.held) AS held, SUM(d.planned) AS planned,
       round(100.0 * SUM(d.held) / NULLIF(SUM(d.planned), 0)) AS held_pct,
       round(SUM(d.rating_avg * d.ratings_n) / NULLIF(SUM(d.ratings_n), 0), 1) AS avg_rating, SUM(d.ratings_n) AS ratings,
       round(SUM(d.attendance_pct * d.held) / NULLIF(SUM(d.held) FILTER (WHERE d.attendance_pct IS NOT NULL), 0)) AS attendance_pct
FROM events.delivery_month d JOIN events.event_types t USING (event_type_id), m
WHERE t.name = 'Advisor session' AND d.month BETWEEN m.s AND m.e AND d.planned > 0

cards.name: 06 · Weekly advisor session · Quantity: per student
cards.sql:
-- P4 KPI 6: Weekly advisor session  (Week)
-- Collection  : Host closes event · advisor notes
-- Quantity    : Sessions held ÷ planned, per student
-- Quality     : Student rating after the session (1–5)
-- Performance : Actions agreed last week that were completed
-- Source      : Event system · ClickUp notes → n8n + LLM
-- Access      : full_access, team_access

WITH m AS (SELECT {{month}}::date AS s, ({{month}}::date + interval '1 month - 1 day')::date AS e), ev AS (SELECT e.* FROM events.events e JOIN events.event_types t USING (event_type_id), m WHERE t.name = 'Advisor session' AND e.held_on BETWEEN m.s AND m.e)
SELECT a.student_id, COUNT(*) AS planned, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE ev.status = 'Held') AS held
FROM ev JOIN events.event_attendance a USING (event_id) GROUP BY a.student_id
UNION ALL
SELECT '(not held, no attendee)', COUNT(*), 0 FROM ev WHERE status <> 'Held'
ORDER BY held, student_id

cards.name: 06 · Weekly advisor session · Performance: agreed actions completed
cards.sql:
-- P4 KPI 6: Weekly advisor session  (Week)
-- Collection  : Host closes event · advisor notes
-- Quantity    : Sessions held ÷ planned, per student
-- Quality     : Student rating after the session (1–5)
-- Performance : Actions agreed last week that were completed
-- Source      : Event system · ClickUp notes → n8n + LLM
-- Access      : full_access, team_access

WITH m AS (SELECT {{month}}::date AS s, ({{month}}::date + interval '1 month - 1 day')::date AS e), ev AS (SELECT e.* FROM events.events e JOIN events.event_types t USING (event_type_id), m WHERE t.name = 'Advisor session' AND e.held_on BETWEEN m.s AND m.e)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS actions_agreed, COUNT(f.completed_on) AS completed,
       round(100.0 * COUNT(f.completed_on) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0)) AS completed_pct
FROM ev JOIN events.event_follow_ups f USING (event_id)

cards.name: 07 · Score targets (Formative, unit test, half-yearly) · Quantity: students with every target set, and all confirmed by parents
cards.sql:
-- P4 KPI 7: Score targets (Formative, unit test, half-yearly)  (Week)
-- Collection  : Automatic · advisor notes
-- Quantity    : % of students with targets set for every subject and exam type, and aligned with parents
-- Quality     : Parent confirmation of targets (yes / no)
-- Performance : Actual vs. target per exam · % of subjects at or above target
-- Source      : Advisor portal · Student app · ClickUp notes → n8n + LLM
-- Access      : full_access, team_access

WITH per AS (
    SELECT s.student_id, COUNT(t.*) AS targets_set, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE t.parent_confirmed) AS confirmed
    FROM students.students s LEFT JOIN students.score_targets t USING (student_id)
    WHERE s.student_id IN (SELECT student_id FROM students.student_month) GROUP BY s.student_id)
SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE targets_set = 15)                    AS all_targets_set,
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE targets_set = 15 AND confirmed = 15) AS all_set_and_parent_aligned,
       COUNT(*)                                                    AS students
FROM per;   -- 5 subjects × 3 exam types = 15

cards.name: 07 · Score targets (Formative, unit test, half-yearly) · Quality: parent confirmation
cards.sql:
-- P4 KPI 7: Score targets (Formative, unit test, half-yearly)  (Week)
-- Collection  : Automatic · advisor notes
-- Quantity    : % of students with targets set for every subject and exam type, and aligned with parents
-- Quality     : Parent confirmation of targets (yes / no)
-- Performance : Actual vs. target per exam · % of subjects at or above target
-- Source      : Advisor portal · Student app · ClickUp notes → n8n + LLM
-- Access      : full_access, team_access

SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE parent_confirmed) AS confirmed, COUNT(*) AS targets,
       round(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE parent_confirmed) / COUNT(*)) AS pct
FROM students.score_targets

cards.name: 07 · Score targets (Formative, unit test, half-yearly) · Performance: actual vs target per exam
cards.sql:
-- P4 KPI 7: Score targets (Formative, unit test, half-yearly)  (Week)
-- Collection  : Automatic · advisor notes
-- Quantity    : % of students with targets set for every subject and exam type, and aligned with parents
-- Quality     : Parent confirmation of targets (yes / no)
-- Performance : Actual vs. target per exam · % of subjects at or above target
-- Source      : Advisor portal · Student app · ClickUp notes → n8n + LLM
-- Access      : full_access, team_access

SELECT r.exam_type, round(AVG(r.score_pct - t.target_pct), 1) AS avg_gap_pts,
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE r.score_pct >= t.target_pct) AS subjects_at_or_above, COUNT(*) AS subjects,
       round(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE r.score_pct >= t.target_pct) / COUNT(*)) AS pct_at_or_above
FROM students.exam_results r JOIN students.score_targets t USING (student_id, subject, exam_type)
GROUP BY r.exam_type ORDER BY MIN(r.exam_on)

cards.name: 08 · Time management · Quantity: students with tasks assigned, per week
cards.sql:
-- P4 KPI 8: Time management  (Week)
-- Collection  : Automatic
-- Quantity    : % of students with tasks assigned this week
-- Quality     : Covered by the timetable pulse
-- Performance : Task completion rate · deadline adherence · time-estimation accuracy (actual ÷ estimated hours)
-- Source      : Student app · Advisor portal
-- Access      : full_access, team_access

WITH m AS (SELECT {{month}}::date AS s, ({{month}}::date + interval '1 month - 1 day')::date AS e), active AS (SELECT sm.student_id FROM students.student_month sm, m WHERE sm.month = m.s),
weeks AS (SELECT w::date AS week FROM m, generate_series(date_trunc('week', m.s), m.e, interval '7 days') w)
SELECT weeks.week, COUNT(DISTINCT t.student_id) AS students_with_tasks,
       round(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT t.student_id) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM active)) AS pct
FROM weeks LEFT JOIN students.tasks t ON t.assigned_on BETWEEN weeks.week AND weeks.week + 6
GROUP BY weeks.week ORDER BY weeks.week

cards.name: 08 · Time management · Performance: completion, deadlines, estimates
cards.sql:
-- P4 KPI 8: Time management  (Week)
-- Collection  : Automatic
-- Quantity    : % of students with tasks assigned this week
-- Quality     : Covered by the timetable pulse
-- Performance : Task completion rate · deadline adherence · time-estimation accuracy (actual ÷ estimated hours)
-- Source      : Student app · Advisor portal
-- Access      : full_access, team_access

WITH m AS (SELECT {{month}}::date AS s, ({{month}}::date + interval '1 month - 1 day')::date AS e)
SELECT (SELECT round(AVG(task_completion_pct), 1) FROM students.student_month WHERE month = m.s)    AS completion_pct,          -- monthly summary
       (SELECT round(AVG(deadline_adherence_pct), 1) FROM students.student_month WHERE month = m.s) AS deadline_adherence_pct,  -- monthly summary
       round(AVG(actual_hrs / NULLIF(estimated_hrs, 0)), 2) AS actual_over_estimated                                            -- task data
FROM students.tasks, m WHERE due_on BETWEEN m.s AND m.e
GROUP BY m.s

cards.name: 09 · Syllabus completion · Quantity: syllabus loaded
cards.sql:
-- P4 KPI 9: Syllabus completion  (Week)
-- Collection  : Automatic
-- Quantity    : % of students whose syllabus is loaded in the advisor portal
-- Quality     : —
-- Performance : % syllabus complete vs. pace target (25% per quarter)
-- Source      : Advisor portal · Student app
-- Access      : full_access, team_access

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.student_id) AS students_with_syllabus,
       (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT student_id) FROM students.student_month) AS students
FROM students.chapters c

cards.name: 09 · Syllabus completion · Performance: syllabus done vs pace, by student
cards.sql:
-- P4 KPI 9: Syllabus completion  (Week)
-- Collection  : Automatic
-- Quantity    : % of students whose syllabus is loaded in the advisor portal
-- Quality     : —
-- Performance : % syllabus complete vs. pace target (25% per quarter)
-- Source      : Advisor portal · Student app
-- Access      : full_access, team_access

SELECT sm.student_id, sm.syllabus_pct, sm.pace_pct, sm.syllabus_pct - sm.pace_pct AS gap,
       sm.syllabus_pct >= sm.pace_pct - 2 AS on_track
FROM students.student_month sm WHERE sm.month = {{month}}::date ORDER BY gap

cards.name: 10 · Rigour of completion · Quantity: monthly re-evaluation done
cards.sql:
-- P4 KPI 10: Rigour of completion  (Week)
-- Collection  : Automatic · advisor notes
-- Quantity    : Monthly re-evaluation done by the advisor (yes / no per student)
-- Quality     : —
-- Performance : Chapter readiness score · rigour adherence: % of chapters marked complete that went through all 5 stages
-- Source      : Student app · ClickUp notes → n8n + LLM
-- Access      : full_access, team_access

SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE reevaluation_done) AS done, COUNT(*) AS students,
       round(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE reevaluation_done) / COUNT(*)) AS pct
FROM ops.advisor_reviews WHERE month = {{month}}::date

cards.name: 10 · Rigour of completion · Performance: readiness and rigour adherence
cards.sql:
-- P4 KPI 10: Rigour of completion  (Week)
-- Collection  : Automatic · advisor notes
-- Quantity    : Monthly re-evaluation done by the advisor (yes / no per student)
-- Quality     : —
-- Performance : Chapter readiness score · rigour adherence: % of chapters marked complete that went through all 5 stages
-- Source      : Student app · ClickUp notes → n8n + LLM
-- Access      : full_access, team_access

SELECT (SELECT round(AVG(readiness), 1) FROM students.student_month WHERE month = {{month}}::date) AS avg_readiness,
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE marked_complete_on IS NOT NULL) AS chapters_complete,
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE marked_complete_on IS NOT NULL AND stages_done = 5) AS through_all_5_stages,
       round(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE marked_complete_on IS NOT NULL AND stages_done = 5)
             / NULLIF(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE marked_complete_on IS NOT NULL), 0)) AS rigour_adherence_pct
FROM students.chapters WHERE marked_complete_on <= ({{month}}::date + interval '1 month - 1 day')::date

cards.name: 11 · Monthly sprints (missed timelines) · Quantity: sprints for students behind
cards.sql:
-- P4 KPI 11: Monthly sprints (missed timelines)  (Week)
-- Collection  : Advisor notes · 1-tap rating
-- Quantity    : Sprints created ÷ students with missed timelines
-- Quality     : Student rating of the sprint
-- Performance : % of sprint chapters recovered by month end
-- Source      : ClickUp notes → n8n + LLM · Student app
-- Access      : full_access, team_access

SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM students.sprints WHERE month = {{month}}::date) AS sprints,
       (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM students.student_month WHERE month = {{month}}::date AND syllabus_pct < pace_pct - 8) AS students_behind_8_pts

cards.name: 11 · Monthly sprints (missed timelines) · Quality: sprint rating
cards.sql:
-- P4 KPI 11: Monthly sprints (missed timelines)  (Week)
-- Collection  : Advisor notes · 1-tap rating
-- Quantity    : Sprints created ÷ students with missed timelines
-- Quality     : Student rating of the sprint
-- Performance : % of sprint chapters recovered by month end
-- Source      : ClickUp notes → n8n + LLM · Student app
-- Access      : full_access, team_access

WITH m AS (SELECT {{month}}::date AS s, ({{month}}::date + interval '1 month - 1 day')::date AS e)
SELECT SUM(d.held) AS held, SUM(d.planned) AS planned,
       round(100.0 * SUM(d.held) / NULLIF(SUM(d.planned), 0)) AS held_pct,
       round(SUM(d.rating_avg * d.ratings_n) / NULLIF(SUM(d.ratings_n), 0), 1) AS avg_rating, SUM(d.ratings_n) AS ratings,
       round(SUM(d.attendance_pct * d.held) / NULLIF(SUM(d.held) FILTER (WHERE d.attendance_pct IS NOT NULL), 0)) AS attendance_pct
FROM events.delivery_month d JOIN events.event_types t USING (event_type_id), m
WHERE t.name = 'Monthly sprint' AND d.month BETWEEN m.s AND m.e AND d.planned > 0

cards.name: 11 · Monthly sprints (missed timelines) · Performance: chapters recovered
cards.sql:
-- P4 KPI 11: Monthly sprints (missed timelines)  (Week)
-- Collection  : Advisor notes · 1-tap rating
-- Quantity    : Sprints created ÷ students with missed timelines
-- Quality     : Student rating of the sprint
-- Performance : % of sprint chapters recovered by month end
-- Source      : ClickUp notes → n8n + LLM · Student app
-- Access      : full_access, team_access

SELECT SUM(chapters_recovered) AS recovered, SUM(chapters_planned) AS planned,
       round(100.0 * SUM(chapters_recovered) / NULLIF(SUM(chapters_planned), 0)) AS recovered_pct
FROM students.sprints WHERE month = {{month}}::date

cards.name: 12 · Advisor inputs · Inputs per advisor
cards.sql:
-- P4 KPI 12: Advisor inputs  (Week)
-- Collection  : Automatic · advisor notes
-- Quantity    : % of students with targets aligned · deviation alerts sent · tutor / academy support assigned when triggered
-- Quality     : —
-- Performance : Inputs, not student outcomes: shown in the advisor view
-- Source      : Advisor portal · n8n alerts · ClickUp notes → n8n + LLM
-- Access      : full_access, team_access

SELECT a.name AS advisor,

WHERE question = 'How was this quarter''s theme?' AND asked_on BETWEEN q.s AND q.e AND 'Entrepreneurship' = 'Entrepreneurship'

cards.name: 23 · Theme: entrepreneurship · Performance: milestones hit, by month
cards.sql:
-- P4 KPI 23: Theme: entrepreneurship  (Quarter)
-- Collection  : Advisor notes · 1-tap rating at quarter end
-- Quantity    : Group projects / active startups ÷ groups / students in the theme
-- Quality     : Student rating at quarter end
-- Performance : Monthly milestones hit ÷ planned
-- Source      : ClickUp notes → n8n + LLM · Student app
-- Access      : full_access, team_access

SELECT to_char(due_month, 'YYYY-MM') AS month, COUNT(*) AS due,
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'Done') AS hit,
       round(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'Done') / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0)) AS hit_pct
FROM students.milestones WHERE track = 'Entrepreneurship' GROUP BY due_month ORDER BY due_month

cards.name: 24 · Summer program applications · Applications

-- P4 KPI 24: Summer program applications  (Quarter)

       COUNT(submitted_on) AS submitted,
       round(100.0 * COUNT(submitted_on) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0)) AS submitted_pct,
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE outcome = 'Accepted') AS accepted
FROM students.summer_applications

cards.name: 27 · Academic roadmap · Academic summary per student for the month
cards.sql:
-- P4 KPI 27: Academic roadmap  (Roadmap)
-- Collection  : See the Week rows
-- Quantity    : See the Week rows
-- Quality     : See the Week rows
-- Performance : See the Week rows: score targets (7), syllabus (9), rigour (10)
-- Source      : —
-- Access      : full_access, team_access

SELECT sm.student_id, sm.syllabus_pct, sm.pace_pct, sm.readiness,
       (SELECT round(AVG(r.score_pct - t.target_pct), 1) FROM students.exam_results r JOIN students.score_targets t USING (student_id, subject, exam_type)
         WHERE r.student_id = sm.student_id) AS avg_gap_to_target
FROM students.student_month sm WHERE sm.month = {{month}}::date ORDER BY sm.student_id

cards.name: 28 · Syllabus completion (roadmap) · On track per subject (within 2 points of pace)
cards.sql:
-- P4 KPI 28: Syllabus completion (roadmap)  (Roadmap)
-- Collection  : Automatic
-- Quantity    : —
-- Quality     : —
-- Performance : On track vs. 25% per quarter (yes / no per subject)
-- Source      : Advisor portal · Student app
-- Access      : full_access, team_access

SELECT subject, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE syllabus_pct >= pace_pct - 2) AS on_track, COUNT(*) AS students,
       round(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE syllabus_pct >= pace_pct - 2) / COUNT(*)) AS pct
FROM students.subject_progress GROUP BY subject ORDER BY pct

cards.name: 29 · Rigour of completion (roadmap) · Rigour adherence per student
cards.sql:
-- P4 KPI 29: Rigour of completion (roadmap)  (Roadmap)
-- Collection  : Automatic
-- Quantity    : —
-- Quality     : —
-- Performance : Rigour adherence (see row 10), per student
-- Source      : Student app
-- Access      : full_access, team_access

SELECT student_id,
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE marked_complete_on IS NOT NULL) AS chapters_complete,
       round(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE marked_complete_on IS NOT NULL AND stages_done = 5)
             / NULLIF(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE marked_complete_on IS NOT NULL), 0)) AS rigour_adherence_pct
FROM students.chapters GROUP BY student_id ORDER BY rigour_adherence_pct
